answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by partitioning the decentralized validator set into three distinct protocol layers, designated jade, sable, and tundra, each requiring a dynamic opportunity-cost bond. By integrating zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions with subgame-perfect slashing matrices, any attempt to multiply identities triggers exponential collateral forfeitures. Consequently, the expected utility of a Sybil strategy remains strictly negative, establishing honest participation as the unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
